text: About ninety minutes into Driftwood Outdoor Apparel's biggest sale of the year, two real dashboards start telling two different stories about the exact same AKS cluster.

The reliability dashboard, built during load-testing, shows checkout-api's p95 latency climbing past two thousand milliseconds and its error rate past five percent. Customers are seeing timeouts at checkout.

Theo pulls up the FinOps dashboard built back in Lesson 7. It says the cluster is fine — average CPU utilization sits at seventy-two percent, under the eighty percent alert line. Plenty of headroom, by that number.
Neither dashboard is wrong. They answer two different questions, and right now those two answers conflict. Next lesson, Theo starts tracing exactly why.
